info.title: MOR Enterprise User Management API
info.description: Public REST API of the Ethiopia Ministry of Revenue (MOR) Enterprise User & Organization Management microservice. Consumed by the Annual Audit Planning system, Risk Engine, Case Management and other MOR services. All endpoints return a `{ data, error, meta }` envelope. Authenticate via POST /auth/login and send the returned JWT as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
